verdict.rationale: LibreChat has a documented Skills feature, an Agent tool-library where users can save up to 100 favorites, and an MCP Settings panel that lets admins add/update MCP servers at runtime without editing config files or restarting — all pointing toward some in-app capability browsing. However, there's no evidence of a curated, browsable public registry/marketplace with one-click install; adding MCP servers still requires knowing server details/config rather than a true app-store style install flow. Missing for 10: a documented public skills/plugin marketplace or registry UI, and a true one-click install flow (vs. runtime config entry) with independent corroboration.
